issue: Initial wrapper checksum manifest included checksum-verify.stdout.txt, whose contents are the output of verification, creating a self-reference.
impact: Browser regression evidence and its raw run are unchanged; only the wrapper integrity check had one packaging mismatch.
preservation: Initial SHA256SUMS and checksum-verify.stdout.txt were copied to *.initial.txt and remain preserved.
correctedProcedure: A new SHA256SUMS.final covers all wrapper artifacts and its verification output is captured outside this directory so checked files remain immutable.
